description: Adversarial and control probes for the two-stage safety architecture. Input probes are user questions run against the pre-retrieval screen; output probes are synthetic model outputs run against the post-generation validator. expect_block/expect_flag encode the clinically required behaviour, not the currently observed one, so a failing probe is a finding rather than a broken test.
